classical_algorithm: RSA-PSS with SHA-256 and X25519 ECDH
cryptographic_operation: Store a sender-authenticated encrypted mailbox message
migration_objective: Integrate ML-KEM recipient encapsulation and ML-DSA sender signatures while preserving active-user and uniqueness checks.
preconditions: Mailbox users and messages are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Only the intended active recipient can decrypt a stored message.
Sender identity and message metadata are authenticated and tampering fails closed.
Message identifiers remain unique and inactive users cannot send or receive.
migration_requirements: Use ML-DSA-65 with a mailbox-specific context for sender signatures.
Use ML-KEM-768, HKDF-SHA-256, and AES-256-GCM for recipient encryption.
Update serialized key formats and integration callers without classical fallback.
verification_procedure: Run original and PQC test suites separately.
Exercise send/receive, wrong recipient, inactive account, message uniqueness, signature verification, serialization, and authenticated encryption.
known_limitations: Synthetic messaging only; not a production communications service.
